Package dev.turboism.sdk.diagnostics

Interface DiagnosticReport

public interface DiagnosticReport
Read-only diagnostic report assembled by the runtime for a plugin context.

Reports describe runtime observations and do not grant access to host internals. Treat problem paths as diagnostic locations, not filesystem paths that a plugin may read or write.
